content.value_statement: AI work can lose important project context across sessions. This skill guides structured capture, storage, and retrieval planning for durable handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Defines inputs for project root, context type, storage format, and semantic tags.
Guides extraction of architecture, decisions, dependencies, and semantic context.
Recommends storage formats including JSON, Markdown, Protocol Buffers, MessagePack, and YAML.
Outlines onboarding and long-running session workflows for context snapshots.
Describes vector database options such as Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant.
Highlights sensitive information exclusion and capture overhead as planning concerns.
limitations: Provides guidance and examples, not a complete executable context-save application.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in this package.
Vector database integration is described at a planning level only.
Users must identify and exclude sensitive information before saving context.

use_cases.title: Prepare Project Onboarding Context
use_cases.description: Capture architecture, dependencies, and decisions before a new AI session or team handoff.

use_cases.title: Maintain Long-Running Session Memory
use_cases.description: Plan recurring snapshots that preserve important state during multi-session AI work.

use_cases.title: Design Retrieval-Ready Knowledge Stores
use_cases.description: Map project knowledge into structured formats and vector database concepts for later retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Capture Basic Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple session handoff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a standard context summary for $PROJECT_ROOT. Focus on goals, current state, key files, decisions, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create Structured Context Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a reusable capture process.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan context capture for $PROJECT_ROOT with $CONTEXT_TYPE detail. Recommend a storage format and include semantic tags.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Long-Running Workflow Snapshots
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for repeated work across sessions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a recurring context snapshot workflow for $PROJECT_ROOT. Include drift detection, versioning, restoration, and sensitive data exclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Design Retrieval Architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for semantic search and knowledge transfer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a retrieval-ready context store for $PROJECT_ROOT. Compare JSON, Markdown, and vector storage options for future AI sessions.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a standard context save plan before ending a feature session.
output_examples.output: A structured handoff brief with project state, architecture notes, active decisions, dependency context, semantic tags, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: A team wants onboarding context for a complex repository.
output_examples.output: An onboarding capture checklist covering project structure, major workflows, decision history, known risks, storage format, and retrieval strategy.

output_examples.input: A knowledge team asks how to support later semantic retrieval.
output_examples.output: A retrieval plan with context categories, tag strategy, vector database considerations, versioning needs, and sensitive information controls.

best_practices: Define the context goal and audience before choosing capture depth.
Review saved context for secrets, personal data, and stale assumptions.
Version context snapshots so later sessions can compare changes.
anti_patterns: Saving entire repositories without prioritizing decisions and active work.
Treating generated context as current without checking recent changes.
Including credentials, private data, or unrestricted logs in saved context.

faq.question: Does this skill save files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for planning context capture and storage choices.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What context formats does it discuss?
faq.answer: It discusses JSON, Markdown, Protocol Buffers, MessagePack, and YAML formats.

faq.question: Does it include real vector database code?
faq.answer: No. It describes vector database concepts and supported options at a planning level.

faq.question: How should sensitive information be handled?
faq.answer: Sensitive information should be reviewed and excluded before any context is saved.

faq.question: When should this skill not be used?
faq.answer: Do not use it for tasks unrelated to context preservation, retrieval, or workflow handoffs.
